responsibility: This module contains the GNU Modula-2 project’s source-maintenance, documentation-generation, and build-support utilities rather than front-end compilation logic itself. Its Python tools manage repository hygiene and developer metadata by normalizing file boilerplate and copyright dates and by checking Meta-format diagnostic strings in Modula-2 and grammar sources, while its documentation generator turns definition modules into Texinfo or Sphinx library manuals by parsing exported declarations and structured comments. Alongside those scripts, the mklink utility supports the gm2 build and link stage by reading module lists and emitting startup code or linker command lines that establish module initialization and final linkage. As a whole, gcc/m2/tools-src is the support-tooling area for maintaining, documenting, and assembling GNU Modula-2 sources and libraries.
